prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A cute flat 2D cartoon sticker of a chubby, round giraffe character laughing hysterically, in the style of a goofy internet reaction meme. The giraffe has a plump, soft, pear-shaped body in pastel butter-yellow with a lighter cream belly patch. It has a short, thick, stubby neck so the head and body merge into one blob, a huge round head, two small ossicones (short horns with round tips) and tiny round ears. A single small curled tuft of hair sits on top of its head. Irregular rounded orange-tan giraffe patches are scattered across its body and cheeks. Its eyes are squeezed shut into happy upturned arcs, with tiny tears of laughter at the corners. Its mouth is stretched wide open in a big crescent, showing a pink tongue and a dark red mouth interior, with a few small teeth. The cheeks are puffed and slightly blushing. The short stubby arms clutch its belly or flail upward, and it has two short legs and a small tail with a tuft. It is slightly tilted back as if cracking up with laughter. Minimal, simple shapes, smooth flat colors, subtle soft shading, thin dark brown outline, a clean plain white background, centered composition, high resolution, kawaii emoji and sticker aesthetic.
